answer: One defense is independent network-origin attestation: each identity must prove it controls a distinct network egress, verified by latency triangulation from independent beacons. One operator behind a connection cannot present dozens of separate origins at once — a plume of traffic cannot rise from many chimneys. Renting a credible origin per fake identity costs money and upkeep every epoch, while an honest agent reuses one origin free. Origins that coincide or fail triangulation lose standing, so a sybil swarm shrinks to the origins its operator can afford, a limit as hard as basalt.
